prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset for Turnip Works, heroic hand-painted miniature game art. One architectural carved CORBEL bracket, not a freestanding statue: a stout wedge-shaped block projecting out from a flat vertical wall mounting back, with a wide FLAT HORIZONTAL TOP shelf to carry a beam. Under that top shelf its front is carved as three thick curling octopus arms with large round suckers. Back is a completely flat vertical plane; top completely flat. No surrounding wall, no beam, no floor pedestal. Dimensions 24 inches wide, 24 deep, 30 tall. The carving dominates the room-facing front and is readable when this bracket sits just under a beam. Front faces +Z, wall mounting back -Z. Palette: violet and pale mauve. Stout connected forms, broad bevels, clear part separation, matte painted gradients, restrained surface texture, no glossy PBR. Exactly one complete object centered with generous clear margin, no scene or additional objects, no text, no logos, no specific published mythology or recognizable product design. Three-quarter view from ABOVE, camera elevation 50 degrees so the top and front are visible. Genuinely transparent background, no floor or cast shadow. Thick reconstructible parts; no wires, chains, delicate horns, thin spikes or isolated floating components.
